Implemented the repairs across all four subsystems:

- Streaming UTF-8 decoding now preserves incomplete characters across chunks; line endings handle CRLF without stripping a lone trailing CR.
- Pagination uses exclusive cursors and continues through short or empty filtered pages, with repeated-cursor and page-budget failures.
- Dependency ordering resolves alias chains and detects cycles by real node identity.
- Layered configuration preserves explicit falsy values, skips `undefined`, and deep-copies arrays and plain-object branches.
